commits.title: Site facts: one statement for what the frame asks about a site's optional features

changes.how: Server-only. export type SiteFacts = { features: string[] | null; visitCounting: boolean; chat: boolean; modals: boolean; referral: { enabled: boolean; cookieDays: number } | null; affiliate: { capture: boolean; captureDays: number } | null; recommendations: boolean; experiments: boolean; platformLangs: number; scanItems: ScannedItem[]; notes: CookieNote[] }. export async function siteFacts(storeId: string | null): Promise<SiteFacts>: 'use cache'; cacheLife('hours'); cacheTag with the union of the tags of the readers it replaces, each copied from its reader: cookiesTag(storeId) (storeFeatures, siteFindings), chatTag(storeId) (getChatAgent), pagesTag(storeId) (usesRememberedModals), and for a store affiliateTag(storeId), recommendTag(storeId), experimentsTag(storeId); for the platform REFERRALS_TAG and LANGUAGES_TAG. One statement built from scalar subqueries, each copied from its reader's own SQL with the same filter: (select features from commerce.stores where id = S) and visit_counting (null for the platform); exists (select 1 from commerce.chat_agents where <owned(storeId)> and enabled) (open toAgent() in src/server/chat-agent.ts to confirm the column that 'enabled' reads); exists (select 1 from commerce.pages where <owner filter> and remembered_modal); for a store the affiliate columns exactly as affiliateSite() selects them (affiliate_program_on, creator_program_on, the two cookie_days) so that capture and captureDays are computed in code by the same lines as affiliateSite() (move those lines into a small exported pure function in src/server/affiliates.ts and call it from both); (select enabled from commerce.recommendation_settings where store_id = S); exists (select 1 from commerce.experiments where store_id = S and status = 'running'); for the platform the referral settings as referralPublicSettings() reads them and the count of enabled platform languages as getPlatformLangs() counts them; (select items from commerce.cookie_scans where <owner filter> and status = 'done' order by finished_at desc limit 1); and the cookie notes as (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('kind', kind, 'name', name, 'domain', domain, 'category', category, 'provider', provider, 'purpose', purpose) order by name), '[]'::jsonb) from commerce.cookie_notes where <owner filter>). Parse scan items with parseScannedItems() and notes with cookieNoteInput as readNotes() does. Read through typedRow() with col. Header comment: which readers it folds, that it keeps exactly their tags, and that the per-feature readers stay for their own screens.

siteCookies() reads const f = await siteFacts(storeId) in place of the Promise.all of the first commit and computes: features = f.features; chat = f.chat; modals = f.modals; referral = f.referral; site/affiliate from f.affiliate; recommendations = f.recommendations; experiments = f.experiments; languages = storeId === null ? f.platformLangs > 1 : Boolean(features && featureOn(features, 'languages')); touch as today from f.visitCounting; items and notes from f.scanItems and f.notes. Delete storeFeatures() and siteFindings() only if rg shows no other caller (rg -n 'storeFeatures\(|siteFindings\(' src); keep readNotes() and listCookieNotes (the admin uses it). The signature and the result of siteCookies() do not change, so its four callers (site-consent.tsx, cookies-section.tsx, platform-routes/cookies.tsx, cookie-scans.ts) are untouched.
